title: Iterate on a hi-fi screen given Design Lead feedback
prompt: Design Lead reviewed the hi-fi on the canvas and said: '1. Primary CTA lacks visual weight — promote to filled accent style. 2. Spacing between form sections is inconsistent — use 24px gap. 3. Missing empty state.' Apply these fixes.
success_criteria: Designer addresses each of the 3 numbered fixes specifically — none skipped.
After fixes, Design Lead re-reviews and emits an updated verdict (Round 2 of 3).
If verdict is 'Production Ready', the artifact is presented to user with what changed.
If still 'Needs Iteration', a third round runs (or escalates to user with caveats after round 3).
No scope expansion — the agent does not 'also fix' unrelated issues without asking.
notes: Tests review-loop iteration discipline and round counting.
